run_basis: Historical Senate polls ending at least 8 days before election; up to 45-day window; latest per pollster; at least 2 pollsters; excludes pollster labels with (D) or (R)
source_warning: Community compiled reported outcomes not independently verified against certified returns. Candidate mismatch, independent candidates and overlapping special races may distort some comparisons.
metric: Mean absolute error in Democratic minus Republican two-party margin, percentage points
next_validation: Reconcile outcomes against certified FEC returns
Exclude races with incompatible candidate matchups, ranked-choice elections, or independent caucus mismatches
Backtest true election-day windows and alternative historical-era weights
Estimate confidence intervals by clustered race resampling
